scope: Only the four recovered current-pool frozen_minion, frozen_hero, taunt and sleep status roots. Static cached original CIL/prefab audit, no client execution.

implementation.cache_key: Actor identity plus original SpellType. Current types: frozen14, taunt8, sleep52. Keep the same Spell/FSM/prefab objects through Birth, Death and None until actual actor release.
implementation.reapply_during_death: ActivateSpellBirthState returns the existing nonnull owned Spell and ActivateState(Birth=1). Interrupt the current FSM state and enter its global Birth route on that same object; do not spawn a second effect or synthesize None first.
implementation.reapply_after_none: Reuse the same cached Spell, leave None through ChangeStateImpl, reset m_finished=false and call OnExitedNoneState. This enables ObjectContainer renderers and then runs the original Birth route.
implementation.old_state_work: Exit the previous FSM state. Its Wait action no longer updates. Cancel its outstanding delayed FSM events because all four keepDelayedEventsOnStateExit=0. Do not let an old Death deadline send None into a later Birth.
implementation.timing: Continue FSM time while temporarily hidden or in None; None does not disable the root GameObject or FSM. Source zero-time state transitions remain frame-quantized. This does not claim every native particle simulation step continues while renderer-culling applies.
implementation.state_domains: Do not conflate Spell.m_finished, Spell.m_activeStateType and PlayMaker active state. Frozen SpellFinishAction at Death entry only sets m_finished=true through OnSpellFinished; activeStateType remains Death=5 until NoneState SpellStateAction reports None.
implementation.renderer_write_order: For ChangeStateImpl, apply original OnExitedNoneState container enable only when the previous Spell state is None, not on every Birth. Separate actual Spell.Show false-to-true while activeStateType!=None also invokes OnExitedNoneState. Apply explicit route SetVisibility actions without resetting all prefab transforms/materials or inventing renderer restoration.
implementation.audio_dedup: Use cached effect serial plus activation/state-entry generation and action identity. A legitimate second Death of the same cached object must play once; old actions must not replay on reattachment.
implementation.release: Actual owner release destroys/releases cached Spell objects. Neither ordinary None nor OnSpellFinished is owner release.

hero_renderer_edge.result: Direct Death-tail to Birth retains disabled hero ice-shell renderers. This is the verified direct source sequence, not an instruction to correct its appearance.
hero_renderer_edge.spell_finish_action: SpellFinishAction.OnEnter 0x06016cdd IL0051..0057 calls Spell.OnSpellFinished for serialized delay0; then action Finish. No ChangeState/Deactivate call.
hero_renderer_edge.spell_finished: Spell.OnSpellFinished 0x0601495f writes m_finished, removes blocks, fires one-shot listeners. It does not write m_activeStateType. Actor.LoadSpell adds release/state-start callbacks, not an ordinary finished-to-None callback.
hero_renderer_edge.conditional_enable: Spell.ChangeStateImpl 0x0601496c IL0037 branches on previous state; IL00b6..00c1 calls OnExitedNoneState only previous None and next non-None. OnExitedNoneState 0x0601498a calls ActivateObjectContainer(true).
hero_renderer_edge.birth_actions: Normal hero Birth: Scale Hero Frame? -> Regular Frame, only ParticlePlay(frost, includeChildren=false) and SetScale(container). No shell enable action. Legacy Birth SpellState targets a Transform-only container and has no animation/renderer action.
hero_renderer_edge.callback_check: Actor.OnSpellStateStarted 0x0601297f calls ActorStateMgr.RefreshStateMgr 0x0601489e, which only calls HighlightState.SetDirty. No container/shell enable is added there.
hero_renderer_edge.after_none: None->Birth does enable both shells as part of ObjectContainer renderer traversal.
hero_renderer_edge.minion_contrast: Normal frozen_minion Birth CheckIfMerc->EnableIce explicitly enables all three ice objects, so direct Death-tail reentry restores them.
hero_renderer_edge.explicit_hide_show_exception: Spell.Show 0x06014935 returns when already m_shown=true. On false-to-true it sets m_shown=true and, if activeStateType!=0, calls OnExitedNoneState before ShowImpl. Therefore a real Hide->Show while still Death enables every active ObjectContainer renderer, including shells hidden by Death. If the Spell reached None while hidden, Show does not enable them. There is no Birth/state reset in this call.
hero_renderer_edge.scope_caveat: This is the direct tag-remove/reapply source path without an intervening independent Actor Hide/Show or release. Do not generalize it to unrelated presentation calls.

audio.no_exit_stop: AudioPlaythroughAction and AudioPlayClipAction directly inherit FsmStateAction, declare no OnExit override, and have no stopOnExit field. FsmStateAction.OnExit 0x06000638 is ret.
audio.frozen_tail: Already-started thaw sound continues when Death is interrupted by Birth and when the FSM enters None. The AudioSource stays on the same active cached prefab; renderer gating does not stop it.
audio.second_frozen_death: Both frozen routes use ordinary SoundManager.Play on their existing AudioSource, not OneShotSound/Clip. PlayImpl 0x06014791 RegisterExtension(newClip=true), LoadClipForPlayback 0x0601475d and InitNewClipOnSource 0x0601475f set the next selected clip, then AudioSource.Play on the same source. Model one reusable playback slot per source: later Death replaces/restarts its prior playback rather than layering another generated source.
audio.taunt_tail: AudioPlayClipAction uses SoundManager.PlayClip with a newly generated SceneObject source. Already-fired taunt audio is independent of cached status state exits. Retain summon/keyword suppression and exact action scheduling from audio/runtime_manifest.json.
audio.sleep: No audio action exists in the recovered sleep root.

particles_and_tweens.action_lifetime: ParticlePlayAction, ParticleStopAction and ParticleClearAction directly inherit FsmStateAction, have no OnExit, and finish immediately after invoking their own operation on the existing ParticleSystem(s). Do not destroy/recreate PS objects on every FSM activation.
particles_and_tweens.play: ParticlePlayAction.OnEnter 0x060000ee calls ParticleSystem.Play(includeChildren). No preceding Clear/Stop/Simulate is implied. Preserve old emitted particles except when an actual source action clears them.
particles_and_tweens.stop: ParticleStopAction.OnEnter 0x060000f4 calls ParticleSystem.Stop(includeChildren). Original Unity managed overload 0x0600005c passes stopBehavior=1, verified enum StopEmitting. It does not clear existing particles.
particles_and_tweens.clear: ParticleClearAction.OnEnter 0x060000df calls ParticleSystem.Clear(includeChildren). This is a separate source action, not destruction of the cached system and not an automatic stop.
particles_and_tweens.frozen_shatter: Death plays shatter systems; Birth has no shatter Clear/Stop action. Already emitted shatter particles retain their own lifetimes through a rapid reapply. Frost Play restarts/resumes the same source system using its native semantics.
particles_and_tweens.none: None only disables ObjectContainer renderers. No blanket ParticleSystem Pause/Stop/Clear follows from None itself. Existing route actions may already have stopped or cleared selected systems.
particles_and_tweens.itween_exit: iTweenFadeToAction.OnExit 0x06000128 and iTweenScaleTo.OnExit 0x060001c0 call iTweenFsmAction.OnExitiTween 0x06000151, remove their callback mapping, and call iTween.Stop(target,itweenType) when stopOnExit is unset or true. Current serialized interrupted sleep/taunt tween actions have stopOnExit=true. Their old tween completion must not overwrite the new state.
particles_and_tweens.native_boundary: Current fields use PauseAndCatchup=1 or AlwaysSimulate=3, not Automatic. Preserve these exact source values as evidence. Native renderer-visibility/culling internals, native ParticleSystem RNG and native integration are not reproduced by this static audit; the portable fixed-step particle model remains a documented compatibility boundary.

async_state_request: WaitThenChangeFsmState.MoveNext 0x06014999 waits until m_fsmReady, then compares current m_activeStateType with the requested stateType before ChangeFsmStateNow. A stale pre-ready request for another state is discarded. ChangeFsmStateNow sends the global enum event.
qa_assertions: After minion thaw then refreeze within3s: same cached serial, Birth route once, original three ice renderers enabled, original shatter tail retained, no old Death Wait later forces None.
After hero thaw then direct refreeze within3s: same serial, normal Birth frost+scale, shell flags remain false as the original direct sequence; after a completed None then Birth both shells enable.
After a completed None then reapply: same serial, not a new prefab; correct container-enable gate then source Birth actions.
A thaw sound is not stopped by immediate Birth. A subsequent thaw on the same effect replaces its source playback slot and is not blocked by same-serial dedup.
Entering None does not reset FSM clock, clear all PS objects or destroy audio; actual Actor release does destroy the cached owned effect.
Sleep/taunt interrupted stopOnExit tweens cannot later write old alpha/scale or send stale completion into a new state.
